semiconductor_relevance: High — Chipmetrics specializes in thin-film metrology solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Chipmetrics is a leader in semiconductor 3D metrology, providing innovative test chips and wafers that enhance process control in thin-film applications. Their technology enables accurate evaluation of high aspect ratio device structures, supporting clients in material development and process optimization to improve yield and accelerate time to market.
capabilities: PillarHall® Lateral High Aspect Ratio (LHAR) Test Chip
Process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
